title: Test-Time Constraint-Aware Diffusion Predictive Control
abstract: arXiv:2611.19380v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion models can learn multimodal distributions over finite-horizon state-input sequences, providing a way to generate candidates for predictive control. However, sequences generated by a pretrained model may violate safety constraints introduced at deployment, for example when obstacles are added or repositioned. Retraining whenever these constraints change limits the usefulness of learned predictive controllers. In this paper, we propose Test-Time Constraint-Aware Diffusion Predictive Control (TCA-DPC), an algorithm for adapting the sampling distribution of a pretrained diffusion controller to newly introduced safety constraints without retraining. We treat the pretrained model as a prior over finite-horizon sequences and define an adapted distribution through exponential tilting based on a constraint-violation penalty. The tilt strength is adjusted online using the fraction of generated sequences that fail constraint verification.

translated_title: 测试时约束感知扩散预测控制
translated_abstract: 扩散模型能够学习有限时域状态-输入序列上的多模态分布，为预测控制提供一种生成候选解的途径。然而，预训练模型生成的序列可能违反部署时新引入的安全约束，例如当障碍物被添加或重新放置时。每当这些约束发生变化时都进行重新训练，会限制已学习预测控制器的实用性。在本文中，我们提出了测试时约束感知扩散预测控制（TCA-DPC），这是一种无需重新训练即可将预训练扩散控制器的采样分布适配到新引入安全约束的算法。我们将预训练模型视为有限时域序列上的先验分布，并通过基于约束违反惩罚的指数倾斜来定义适配后的分布。倾斜强度根据未通过约束验证的生成序列比例进行在线调整。
tldr: 该论文提出TCA-DPC算法，无需重新训练即可通过基于约束违反惩罚的指数倾斜（倾斜强度在线自适应调整），在测试时将预训练扩散控制器的采样分布适配到部署时新引入的安全约束。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TCA-DPC, an algorithm that adapts a pretrained diffusion controller's sampling distribution to newly introduced safety constraints at test time without retraining, using exponential tilting based on constraint-violation penalties with an online-adjusted tilt strength.
